Enchanted Wilds

TFT Set 18 build guide, patch 18.2

Outlined champions are frontline units.

    Each square is the item made from its row and column components. Hover or tap one for its stats.

      Artifacts come from anvils, augments and encounters. Portraits show the champions who place best holding each one.

      Builds and comps come from Mobalytics. Artifact placements come from MetaTFT ranked games, Platinum and above, patch 18.3. Icons are from Mobalytics and Community Dragon.
